description: Patients who have at least one examination whose recorded ANA pattern is something other than S.

d.request: For patients with at least one examination whose recorded `ANA Pattern` is non-null and not 'S', list each ID and sex (from Patient) with the unrounded average `aCL IgM` over all their Examination rows (NULLs ignored), grouped by ID and sex, sorted descending with NULL averages last, top 10.
d.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND `ANA Pattern` <> 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (avg_acl_igm IS NULL), avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10;

c.request: Among patients whose examinations don't show an `ANA Pattern` of 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10. Patients who have at least one examination whose recorded ANA pattern is something other than S.
c.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination s WHERE s.ID = p.ID AND s.`ANA Pattern` = 'S') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination n WHERE n.ID = p.ID AND n.`ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND n.`ANA Pattern` <> 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_acl_igm IS NULL, avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10;

a.request: For patients with at least one examination record whose `ANA Pattern` is recorded and is something other than 'S', list each patient's ID, their sex (from the Patient table, only patients present there), and the average `aCL IgM` across all of their examinations (ignoring missing values, unrounded). Group by patient ID and sex, sort by that average from highest to lowest with missing averages last, and show the top 10.
a.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> '' AND `ANA Pattern` <> 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY avg_acl_igm IS NULL, avg_acl_igm DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: Patients who have at least one Examination row where `ANA Pattern` is non-null and not equal to 'S', listed with their ID, sex (from Patient), and average aCL IgM across all their Examination rows (NULLs ignored).
b.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_acl_igm FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Examination WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL AND `ANA Pattern` <> 'S') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX;
